change.title: Extract the managed Science launch phase owner
change.summary: Moves the contiguous managed Science launch, health, identity, receipt, and bounded DB-recovery phase out of the cold one-click coordinator while preserving its checkpoint order, failure projection, AppState updates, and compensation inputs.

basis: run_cold_one_click retains prior-stop, authority capture, Gateway, route, finalize, and the single existing compensation funnel
run_managed_science_launch_phase exclusively owns the contiguous StartScienceEnvironmentPending through DB reverify and bounded-restart phase
the phase consumes explicit frozen Gateway, SSH, authority, transaction identity, journal progress, and rollback context inputs from the cold coordinator
the phase returns only the existing best-effort registration status while mutating the same journal progress and rollback context used by compensation
checkpoint count and order, complete-record CAS, launch/health/identity/receipt sequence, AppState updates, DTOs, visible text, locks, and compensation behavior remain unchanged
Rust AST and Python source-boundary tests verify one cold dispatch, phase-only Science launch ownership, typed adapter use, and the unchanged journal/finalize funnel
prior-stop, authority, Gateway, route, finalize, and durable compensation changes remain excluded
read-model, update provenance, artifact, installed/live, signing, and release evidence remain excluded
